## Description
A concise description of what this pull request does.

## Changes
- [ ] Code changes
- [ ] Configuration updates
- [ ] Documentation updates

## Types of Changes
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change that fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change that adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that could affect backward compatibility)
- [ ] Documentation change

## Testing
- [ ] Environment setup
- [ ] Build and deploy environment
- [ ] Manual testing
- [ ] Automated tests

## Related Issues
- [ ] Related to this issue
- [ ] References this issue

## Accessibility Considerations
- [ ] Keyboard navigation tested
- [ ] Screen reader tested
- [ ] Color contrast tested
- [ ] Semantic HTML verified
- [ ] ARIA attributes checked

## SEO Considerations
- [ ] Meta title
- [ ] Meta description
- [ ] Meta keywords
- [ ] Open Graph tags
- [ ] Twitter card tags
- [ ] Breadcrumb schema

## Performance Considerations
- [ ] Asset optimization
- [ ] Image optimization
- [ ] Code splitting
- [ ] Bundle size impact

## Preview
**Preview site:** https://your-repo-name.vercel.app *(Update this with your actual preview URL)*

**Screenshots or Video:** *(Add screenshots demonstrating the changes, ideally on mobile and desktop)*

## Additional Considerations
**It's recommended to use [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) for commit messages.** Example formats:
- `feat: add new feature`
- `fix: resolve issue with X`
- `docs: update README`
- `style: format code`
- `refactor: refactor X component`
- `test: add tests for Y`

If special approval is needed for this change (e.g., due to security implications or significant UI changes), specify it here.
